title: coleus trullatus
intro: Coleus trullatus, commonly known as Coleus, is a perennial plant species native to tropical Asia and belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Coleus trullatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
